_note: Neo's PUBLISHED comparison table. plan-features.json (Pandora) is the source of truth and wins wherever the two differ — confirmed by Hari 03 Sep. This file is the marketing simplification: it is the customer's mental model and a useful cross-check, not an authority. Where the page shows MAX ONLY and Pandora shows lower, the page is under-stating for a compact table.

_conflictsWithPandora.signature_builder: pricing page: MAX ONLY. plan-features.json: 'STANDARD and MAX'. Our `look_established` need forces STANDARD citing this.
_conflictsWithPandora.drive_storage: pricing page: Drive is MAX ONLY. plan-features.json: 'Standard (1,024) and Max (51,200). Absent from Starter.'
_conflictsWithPandora.ai_summary: pricing page: MAX ONLY. plan-features.json: 'All three, limit 4 on Starter and Standard.'
_conflictsWithPandora.advanced_tracking: pricing page: MAX ONLY. plan-features.json: 'All three, limited: Starter 5, Standard 5, Max unlimited.'
_conflictsWithPandora.sendLimitPerDay: pricing page: Starter 500 / Standard 1000 / Max 1000 per day. plan-features.json sendLimitPerDay: max 2000. Nothing reads it today.
_conflictsWithPandora._resolution: PANDORA WINS on all five. Recorded so nobody re-derives them from the page and 'corrects' the code in the wrong direction. What this table IS good for: catching a floor we assert that NEITHER source supports — which is how the attachments mis-citation was found.
_conflictsWithPandora._whichOnesActuallyMatter: TWO of the five change a live recommendation, and both sit on the SAME line: does Standard have it, or only Max? `drive_storage` carries room_for_attachments (photos and documents -> Standard) and `signature_builder` carries look_established (moving off a personal address -> Standard). Under Pandora both are Standard+ and Standard is reachable. If the pricing page were right on either, that route collapses to Max and the tier gets much harder to reach. `ai_summary`, `advanced_tracking` and `sendLimitPerDay` are recorded for completeness and are read by nothing. Note both sources AGREE Drive is absent from Starter — the disagreement is only about Standard, which is exactly the boundary our two Standard needs rest on.
